The '''Mysterious Garden''' (Japanese: '''ふしぎのはなぞの''' ''Mysterious Flower Garden'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]] that appeared in ''[[EP051|Bulbasaur's Mysterious Garden]]''. It's a location where {{p|Bulbasaur}} from all over the {{pkmn|world}} are said to gather every year for a festival to [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Ivysaur}} en masse.

==History==
When [[Ash's Bulbasaur]] started showing signs of evolving, a group of {{pkmn2|wild}} Bulbasaur forcibly brought it to the Mysterious Garden, prompting {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} to follow. A {{p|Venusaur}} appeared from a giant tree and [[Cry|cried out]] as all the wild Bulbasaur evolved into Ivysaur. However, Ash's Bulbasaur refused to evolve, angering Venusaur, which tried to hit it with {{m|Vine Whip}}, but Ash took the blow and defended Bulbasaur's right to stay unevolved if it so chose. {{TRT}} subsequently appeared and tried to capture all of the Ivysaur, but Ash's Bulbasaur managed to save them by using its newly learned {{m|Solar Beam}}, after which the villainous trio was sent [[blasting off]] by a collective Vine Whip from all the Bulbasaur evolutionary line members. Accepting Bulbasaur's choice, Venusaur and the Ivysaur then let it leave the Mysterious Garden without evolving alongside Ash and his friends.
